LD-ONB2-PED-AOM-DX.rationale: CLM-ONB2-AOM-DX explicitly states AOM diagnosis requires acute symptoms plus inflammatory otoscopic findings (not effusion alone), and CLM-ONB2-AOM-SIGNS specifies bulging TM as an inflammatory sign supporting AOM. Together these directly entail the decision statement's diagnostic criteria for the stated population with no added leap.

LD-ONB2-PED-AOM-OBSERVE.rationale: CLM-ONB2-AOM-OBSERVE states verbatim that mild AOM in otherwise healthy children >=6 months permits observation with analgesia and reassessment in 24-48h. This matches the decision statement's population, condition (mild AOM), and action (observe rather than treat immediately) exactly.

LD-ONB2-PED-ASTHMA-IMAGE.rationale: CLM-ONB2-ASTHMA-IMAGING says chest radiography 'can investigate' persistent asymmetry or suspected complication -- a permissive/optional framing, not an imperative. Statement asserts more directive certainty than the claim supports.

LD-ONB2-PED-ASTHMA-MAG.rationale: CLM-ONB2-ASTHMA-MAGNESIUM says to 'consider' IV magnesium, not a firm instruction. Statement asserts more directiveness than the claim conveys.

LD-ONB2-PSY-AUD-INTERVIEW.rationale: CLM-ONB2-AUD-INTERVIEW states verbatim that a high-risk positive alcohol screen requires a DSM-5-TR diagnostic interview, an exact match.

LD-ONB2-PSY-AUD-WITHDRAWAL.rationale: The claim addresses risk stratification and benzodiazepine-based management but does not textually address site-of-care (monitored/inpatient vs outpatient), which is the core of the decision statement; the claim text is also noted truncated in extraction.

LD-ONB2-PSY-AUD-REDUCTION.rationale: CLM-ONB2-AUD-GOAL differentiates naltrexone (reduction or abstinence) from acamprosate (abstinence only), entailing naltrexone for a reduction goal; CLM-ONB2-AUD-OPIOIDS supplies the no-contraindication condition.

LD-ONB2-PSY-AUD-ABSTINENCE.rationale: CLM-ONB2-AUD-GOAL establishes acamprosate for abstinence; CLM-ONB2-AUD-OPIOIDS states opioid use/hepatic disease contraindicate naltrexone, matching the decision's stated trigger for choosing acamprosate.

LD-ONB2-SURG-CROUP-DX.rationale: CLM-ONB2-CROUP-DX states verbatim that typical croup combines barking cough, hoarseness and inspiratory stridor; CLM-ONB2-CROUP-RED-FLAGS supports the exclusion of atypical presentations.

LD-ONB2-SURG-CROUP-STEROID.rationale: CLM-ONB2-CROUP-STEROID states corticosteroids benefit mild through severe croup and oral dexamethasone is preferred when tolerated, directly entailing the statement.

LD-ONB2-SURG-CROUP-EPINEPHRINE.rationale: CLM-ONB2-CROUP-REST-STRIDOR defines resting stridor+indrawing as characterizing 'moderate' croup only, not severe; the statement's parenthetical extends this definition to the broader moderate/severe category, an unstated extension.

LD-ONB2-SURG-CROUP-DISCHARGE.rationale: CLM-ONB2-CROUP-DISCHARGE states verbatim the exact discharge criterion in the decision statement.
